name: Sundrel Cabinet 110 Original
description: This listing is a dunite-shell calender roller listed with working width 180 centimetres, process temperature 14 degrees Celsius, batch throughput 33.6 kilograms. Its remaining stated figures are cycle hours 70 hours, unit price set after acceptance, drive type fully manual.
